newsitem.title: ITALY: RUGBY UNION-ITALY NAMES SQUAD FOR ENGLAND MATCH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ITALY NAMES SQUAD FOR ENGLAND MATCH.

text.p: Italy on Tuesday named a 21-man squad for their rugby union friendly match against England at Twickenham on November 23.

Back row Corrado Covi gets a recall after five years out of the national team while captain Massimo Cuttitta has recovered from the thigh injury that forced him to miss Italy's home international against Australia last month.
Officials said the squad would gather to train south of Rome next Monday and would fly to England on November 21.

Squad: Andrea Castellani, Walter Cristofoletto, Ivan Francescato, Leandro Manteri, Diego Scaglia, Andrea Sgorlon, Alessandro Troncon, Orazio Arancio, Massimo Cuttitta, Diego Dominguez, Carlo Orlandi, Franco Properzi Curti, Stefano Bordon, Andrea Scanavacca, Massimo Ravazzolo, Paolo Vaccari, Andrea Barattin, Corrado Covi, Gianluca Guidi, Javier Pertile, Massimo Giovanelli.
